reviews.title: I struggled to get the app to load content
reviews.text: This app was so disappointing. I was very excited about Artemis II content and the interactive feature. But the app often failed to load key images and stories. And the interactive Artemis feature failed to work at all.

reviews.title: So difficult to find update information and pics
reviews.text: I go on there to see update photos and location of the mission and I can never find what I want.  I see pics posted on other media formats but never on this app.  You have some of the smartest people in the world world there this could be much much better.

reviews.title: Buggy, cookie-cutter, low info
reviews.text:
Really bad and buggy UI. Low information density. Ugly design. Uninspired.

How can random nerd websites on the internet be so much more useful and interesting than the official NASA app?

reviews.title: New video player still not right
reviews.text:
1) The new video player auto rotates to landscape immediately, but still does not fill the screen effectively. There’s a black bar at the bottom (iPhone 16 pro). Ok, used the double arrow to expand it. Nice. But now I lose my controls for player settings. And there are two Xs to close it instead of a standard swipe. This is the consumer world of IT *not* a spacecraft - why is it over-complicated?

2) also, The email to technical support using the technical support option in the settings Menu of the app does Not work either. The mail will not send.

3) also, 50 characters without a character counter is a bit frustrating.

reviews.title: Does not work

reviews.title: Image of the day doesn’t work
reviews.text: Image of the day doesn’t work, which is the main reason I got the app.

reviews.title: Lots of glitches
reviews.text: Lots of glitches. The app isn’t usable.

reviews.title: Worthless
reviews.text:
I wrote a review several days ago but evidently it was too harsh and deleted. 

It’s an app with a bunch of links to web pages. The AR/VR is terribly buggy and doesn’t work 90% of the time. I downloaded this to track Artemis II progress like NASA advertised and I can’t track anything. No live video. No live mission audio. No map. Just links to news article web pages and old pictures and videos. It’s 2026 NASA, let’s “get with the program”.

reviews.title: Interactive live VR doesn’t work
reviews.text: The VR feature doesn’t work most of the time. It worked a little earlier today but won’t work now.

reviews.title: Artemis section not working properly.
reviews.text: It does not load quickly and sometimes not at all. I’ve had to delete the app and reinstall it to get that section working again.  If you click the settings icon, you can’t get out of it and have to shut down and restart the Artemis section.  Needs a lot of work.

reviews.title: Similar to Artemis II
reviews.text: This app reminds me of Artemis rocket 🚀 it works but clunky and a lot of work to use. Hopefully not developed by NASA

reviews.title: AV/VR feature doesn’t work on iphone 17 pro
reviews.text: Crashes soon after I start using the feature and won’t work thereafter unless I delete/reinstall the app. Disappointing. Another missed public engagement opportunity by NASA.

reviews.title: Provide option for measurements in metric
reviews.text:
Love the moon, love the science, love the miracle. 
Not loving mental gymnastics like it’s 1969 to convert imperial to metric. You can fly a rocket to the moon so you can also provide a toggle for metric given most of the world uses that. Please and thank you.

reviews.title: The app feels like it’s from 2010
reviews.text: Very prototype “homemade” feel, not something I would expect from NASA.

reviews.title: Naja

reviews.title: Crashes
reviews.text: Try and view anything live and it crashes.

reviews.title: Extra poor use of an app
reviews.text: So, I figured I’d be able to enjoy live coverage of the mission. Lol!! It’s laughable, a tiny screen of Mission Control and the bigger screen is a computer generated image of .,. Who knows. Your live coverage of Artemis 2, is that of out of focus rocket, wandering camera shot and the crowd right at booster separation!!! It’s a joke, you all should be deeply embarrassed! It’s 2026! Regular people have better coverage than you.

reviews.title: AROW is so close
reviews.text:
But it’s not optimized for the iPhone. 

Dynamic Island goes right on top of key user interfaces if you use it in landscape mode. Nothing is cropped for ease of use and readability. Not having two finger zoom is painful. 

And the Artemis tracker circle scales as you zoom in and out, seemingly increasing uncertainty of where it is. 

I love love the concept though.

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text:
Very glitzy, very fancy, all flash. No substance. 

Built for twenty something social media addicts. 

I miss the old NASA.

reviews.title: Artemis II
reviews.text: Pretty disappointed with the Artemis II  section of the app. It’s an unusable crowded mess. Like I want to simply know where the crew is and some basic metrics about the mission, that should be super easy to find and use but instead you have find and launch the VR interface and fight with the controls to just see a map. Extremely nerdy and complicated. A flat 2D simple map with live stats would have been so much useful.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: Downloaded the app to track Artemis mission. Tracker not working and very clunky.

reviews.title: Artemis 2 tracker
reviews.text: Artemis live tracker doesn’t work. No buttons on screen, tutorial text off screen. Doesn’t load any tracking data. This is for iPhone 14. Honestly worst attempt for an app I’ve ever seen by any government agency. Gov.uk is better.

reviews.title: Inexcusable
reviews.text:
How, with 16 years of lead up to Orion’s first manned lunar mission, do you not build a functional tracker for mobile devices??? 

The Artemis launch should be a case study moment in how amazing an app can be for a major human milestone. It should make this mission more accessible for humanity. But it is absolutely awful. 

The fact that we’re getting THIS disaster at such a huge moment in history is an embarrassment and everyone involved should feel embarrassed.

reviews.title: Unusable
reviews.text: If you want people to get interested in science, especially about space exploration, perhaps you should rethink your app only because it is quite unusable. I can watch missions on YouTube, but why not on this app???

reviews.title: Artemis Tracker non functional

reviews.title: Artemis II launch coverage and visualizations in app are dismal
reviews.text: I want to be a fan of NASA and government in general, but for the billions they spend, put a few bucks into production quality. Poor production, poor editing, poor visualizations, tracker is terrible… it’s just amateur hour in terms of design and production value for what is a major part of selling all this expensive exploration to the public who pays for all this. Just depressing.

reviews.title: Glitchy
